name: Killing Fate
source:
A short Urban Fantasy/Horror game with four possible endings, none of them particularly “good.” It focuses on the current reincarnation of the mythological Three Fates as men in today’s world, who hunger to feed from the ordinary citizens whose lives they can dictate at will. Two of them begin to suspect that the youngest is only faking his powers, and consider getting rid of him once and for all.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/kfvn.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
一款简短的都市奇幻/恐怖游戏，有四种可能的结局，但没有一个特别“好”。它关注的是神话中的命运三女神现在转世为当今世界的男人，他们渴望从普通公民那里获得食物，而普通公民的生活可以由他们随意支配。其中两个人开始怀疑最小的孩子只是在伪造自己的力量，并考虑一劳永逸地摆脱他。

[来自[url=http://renai.us/game/kfvn.shtml]仁爱档案馆[/url]]
